{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders
# Only completed orders count for conversion rate
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders
qa_check = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_check)}")

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df_completed[df_completed['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Compute conversion rates by channel (unadjusted)
conversion_rate_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate_paid_search = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
unadjusted_diff = conversion_rate_email - conversion_rate_paid_search

# Compute within-segment differences
segment_diffs = []
for seg in df_clean['customer_segment'].unique():
    seg_data = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == seg]
    channels_in_seg = seg_data['channel'].unique()
    if len(channels_in_seg) < 2:
        continue
    conv_email = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    conv_paid = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff = conv_email - conv_paid
    segment_diffs.append(diff)
    # Print each difference for audit
    print(f"Within-segment difference for {seg}: {diff:.4f}")

# Compute average difference (stratified)
adjusted_diff = sum(segment_diffs) / len(segment_diffs)
print(f"Adjusted difference (stratified): {adjusted_diff:.4f}")

# Print segment-level conversion rates
segment_channel_conv = df_clean.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("Segment-level conversion rates:")
print(segment_channel_conv)

# Print channel-wise segment distribution
channel_segment_dist = df_clean.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print("Channel-wise segment distribution:")
print(channel_segment_dist)"}
